title: Quantum Mixed-State Shadow v1 — synthetic stress
phase_alignment_definition: cos(mean_phase_A - mean_phase_B) with circular mean atan2(Σsin,Σcos); null if resultant length ≈ 0

E_purity_spread_effects.note: Holding mean phase fixed, higher purity mismatch / spread drives F below the pure-state (1+cosΔ)/2 curve via the sqrt((1-|r|^2)...) term and reduced |r|.

linear_residual_vs_phase_alignment.note: Residual fraction is a lower-bound proxy for information not captured by mean-phase cos(Δ).

F_independent_information.verdict: YES — mixed-state QI carries purity/spread geometry beyond cos(Δφ̄).

G_pathological_redundant_cases.detail: When both ensembles are nearly pure, qi_mixed_fidelity ≈ (1+phase_alignment)/2; RMSE=0.012713186550735656 on n=61.
Identical dispersed ensembles yield F=1 even when purity≈0.5; mean phase may be undefined.
When Σe^{iφ}≈0, phase_alignment_mean is undefined while QI still returns purity/F/trace.

H_recommendation.rationale: Mixed-state fidelity varies materially at fixed mean-phase alignment when purity/spread differ; residual vs phase_alignment is non-trivial. Keep as separate shadow diagnostic, not fused.
